Safety+ version 2.0 is here!

Built on client feedback, we’ve packed the Safety+ integrated safety solution full of powerful updates to deliver more insights, more customised setup options, and an overall smoother experience.

With the upgraded Safety+ 2.0, you can:

Optimise oversight and decision-making with built-in dashboard reporting. Tailor the solution to your organisation through upgraded configuration options. Validate and share important data quickly and easily via improved data export features. In addition to the release of Safety+ 2.0, we’re excited to also launch the all-new Forwood Safety+ mobile app.

Designed to complement the upgraded web portal, the new mobile solution lets you verify multiple risks and controls in the one workflow – no more jumping in and out of the app.

Read on for an overview of what’s new in Safety+ 2.0 and the Forwood Safety+ mobile app.

Safety+ 2.0 simplifies and enhances data management Overall, the Safety+ 2.0 upgrade simplifies and improves the management of important data, making it easier to access, share, and report on key information from within the web portal.

Each feature of Safety+ 2.0 has been meticulously designed to prevent incidents and save lives. Key highlights include:

Track, analyse, and report from within the solution Advanced dashboard reporting capabilities put key data and insights at your fingertips, allowing you to access important and comprehensive reports from inside the Safety+ web portal.

Delivering standardized and reliable visualisations of safety metrics and activities, the new comprehensive dashboards include:

Compliance Trends. Track overall compliance, structure-level data, and trends over time. Non-Compliance Analysis. Visualise non-compliance by risk and structure level, with detailed record tables. Participation Metrics. View verifier activity, participation rates, and details verification records. Incident Overview. Analyse incidents by severity and status, with a focus on recent occurrences. Action Plan Status. Monitor action completion rates and overdue actions by structure or work area. Tailor to what you want to see  During onboarding, you can now opt for a customised setup to accommodate your organisation’s specific preferences and requirements. For example:

Configure company-specific dropdown values. Show or hide modules. Exclude unsuitable methods of analysis. These new options ensure each client’s configuration remains separate and exclusive to their needs.

For a seamless experience across your operations, improved flexibility allows you to customise content, such as logos and terminology. Global teams are also better served with multi-language support.

In addition, a self-service update in Safety+ 2.0 lets you maintain your own critical control verification checklists in the web solution.

Review and share information efficiently   New export features make it quicker and easier to validate, move, and share important information. All transactional data can now be exported with intense filtering options, such as the ability to only export records that are overdue or incomplete.

Process data faster across teams  For clients with multiple business units, new bulk data processing options enable a smooth and fast flow of information across teams.

In conjunction with Safety+ 2.0, we’ve developed the all-new Forwood Safety+ mobile app.

Designed for the upgraded web portal, the new app is a requirement for Safety+ users who upgrade to version 2.0 and use the solution to complete critical control verifications. 

Here is a quick overview of the app’s exciting new features.

Verify multiple risks with the new Forwood Safety+ mobile app  Forwood Safety+ is the native, dedicated mobile app for the Safety+ 2.0 solution. Built for improved user experience, the app streamlines the critical control verification process for a simpler and more efficient workflow.

Effectively, the Forwood Safety+ app incorporates our patented three-tiered Critical Control Verification Checklists in a faster and more reliable mobile solution. Intuitive interfaces ensure the checklists are accessible and straightforward to use, from frontline workers to supervisors and management.

While working online or offline, the new Forwood Safety+ app lets you:

Select multiple risks in one verification  Get to worker faster by verifying all the risks at once. The new multi-risk verification feature lets you select and verify the multiple risks of a job in a single view, streamlining the verification process.

Select multiple controls in one session Like with risks, the Forwood Safety+ mobile app allows you to choose and verify multiple controls for the selected risks in the one workflow. This ensures comprehensive safety coverage and keeps processes to a minimum.

Create integrated action plans Capture and establish missing critical controls with enhanced Action Plan management. New capabilities enable the creation of action plans directly during verification, ensuring quick follow-ups and task management.

Configure content and geolocate risk verifications Tailor Forwood Safety+ to your operations with configurable content including images, questions, answer types, and tool tips, and geolocate risk verifications using geospatial tools.

Experience enhanced performance and stability The Forwood Safety+ app is optimised for speed and performance, reducing load times when connectivity is limited or unavailable. Improved stability and enhanced offline capabilities let you navigate the app without interruption even during extensive field operations.

The Forwood Safety+ mobile app is available for registered users of the Safety+ solution to download on the Apple App and Google Play stores.

To learn more about the Safety+ solution and how it can meet your organisation’s unique safety requirements, get in touch or read more here.
